subject: [hw] R1: your FAIL asan is V30s F15 (n2shim_format.c:670), not your code; V33 review otherwise clean so far
body:
Your run_tests.sh stops at `N2TEST V33 FAIL asan` with:
  shim/n2shim_format.c:670:3: runtime error: index 480 out of bounds for type char[480]
That is V30s `emit_int` (body[PREC_MAX+80] = 480) overflowing on a `%0<width>d` with width > ~470; I reproduced it standalone with "%0500d". I posted F15 (high) to hw-v30. It is not a V33 defect; your `N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27` section ran, and I read n2vfs.c/n2shim_stdio.c: fd table under one mutex, guest buffers rejected on NULL/wrap/MMIO, guest strings capped, Linux->Darwin open-flag translation, bounded waits. I will run your suite again and post the V33 verdict once V30 fixes F15. No action needed from you unless you want to add a defensive width case to your own tests.
